gist: Sensei promised to get Koyuki's confiscated handheld console back from the Seminar lost-and-found before her 16:00 Self-Reflection Room slot, texted at 13:50 that he had forgotten to ask, then spent the afternoon persuading Yuuka and Ren to release it and delivered it at 15:55 with a signed loan form in his own name.
